About me

Built on data.
Driven by results.

I'm Joseph Gilbert Peñaranda, a performance marketing specialist based in Bacolod City, Philippines, with over 20 years of remote work experience serving US clients. I hold an MBA in Entrepreneurship and a BSBA in Marketing Management from the University of St. La Salle.

I specialize in paid media buying across Meta, Google Ads and TikTok, managing campaigns with millions in ad spend. Beyond media buying, I build end-to-end GoHighLevel systems: CRM setups, workflow automations, funnels and integrations that turn leads into revenue on autopilot.
